overview_description.description:
Sourcery is developing a payments and commerce platform that focuses on the wholesale foodservice industry, a $220B market that still runs on 1980s technology: buyers search for products in paper catalogs, submit orders by fax or phone, and deal with paper invoices and checks.  Sourcery's platform brings all of these transactions online. 

Sourcery enables companies of all sizes to handle their AP needs in one place. We turn a stack of invoices into a boatload of insights automagically. We work with leading restaurateurs, operators and accountants to build the best accounts payable solution for the industry. Owners and executives of multi-unit restaurant organizations rely on Sourcery to provide a scalable solution to help them create efficiencies, and, ultimately, grow their business, while impacting their bottom line. Sourcery integrates with most accounting software and restaurant management applications.

We use a combination of computation and human verification to have the best in class extraction of structured data from invoices down the the line item. Our data analytics automatically detect anomalies and notify purchasers about rising prices.

Customers include Palantir, Dropbox, Airbnb, Stripe as well as restaurants, caterers, and other food businesses.

Call toll free on +1-(866)830-0691

product.name: AP and AR Automation Solution
product.description: Sourcery Technologies offers an automated solution for managing accounts payable and receivable, integrating with most accounting software and restaurant management applications to process, extract, and transfer data.

product.name: Invoice Storage
product.description: This service converts all invoices into digital data for easy access and management, allowing users to search by various criteria such as date range, invoice number, and vendor.

product.name: Analytics
product.description: Provides real-time spend analytics to track purchases and make informed decisions, helping users to identify outliers and track high volume purchases.

product.name: Online Bill Pay
product.description: Enables users to pay vendors with a single click from any web-enabled device, streamlining the accounts payable process.

product.name: High-Touch Services
product.description: Offers a dedicated team to help manage vendor relations, invoice data entry, and review of weekly/monthly statements, ensuring accuracy and timeliness in payments.

product.name: Outsourced Data Entry
product.description: Allows for the outsourcing of invoice data entry, reducing staff time and eliminating errors in the process.
